items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: when George Floyd was killed one of his clients saw the police and stuff deal with George Floyd before he was murdered.

ctx.x: So she’s staying with me now and my dad taught me something because he made sure that he was going to take care of his family. He built a house in [inaudible] Missouri for his mom and dad, and he made sure that he, as his success rose that he made sure he took care of them. We were really a pretty close family. So that kind of challenges me a lot. The racial situation challenges me. I have a son who is an attorney and actually this is interesting — when George Floyd was killed one of his clients saw the police…
